intro-section.title: Witamy!
intro-section.intro:
We’re getting married in Poland to celebrate our shared heritage and our future together.

We hope you can join us!

getting-there.info: Shuttles will be available from Beskidian and parking is also available on-site. Details to come.

notes.info: We will be having a symbolic wedding ceremony in the castle courtyard. Please dress to be outdoors.

getting-there.info: Shuttles will be available from the ceremony. More info to come.

notes.info: Cocktail hour and brunch will take place in the outdoor gazebo.

accommodations.details: Accommodations at Beskidian Hotel for the night of the wedding (Saturday 12th) are included. Details and room assignments will be provided after RSVP. If you are attending the bachelor/ette, an additional night at Beskidian will be included in the cost and RSVP. Otherwise, if you would like to arrive early or extend your stay at Beskidian, please reach out directly to the hotel: <TODO>

dress-code.details:
Cocktail attire. Be prepared for dancing and for outdoor weather. The ceremony will be held in a castle courtyard with uneven cobblestone and cocktail hour will be held on a lawn. Weather in Poland in September is typically pleasant but can vary between hot, cold and rainy.

General guidance:
Ankle to knee length dresses
Suit pants and button down shirt. Suit jackets, vests, ties or bow-ties optional.
Classy but comfortable shoes for dancing and outdoor celebrations.
Shawl, additional layer and/or umbrella recommended in case of rain or cool weather.

Please avoid wearing white, cream or overly bright/vivid colors due to the historical setting of the ceremony.

schedule-section.title: Week at a Glance
schedule-section.description: We’ve planned a few activities leading up to the wedding for friends, foreign guests, and those arriving at the hotel early. Your wedding invitation will list the events you are included on.

welcome-drinks.title: Welcome Drinks
welcome-drinks.details: For those arriving at the venue on or before Friday Sept 11, we will be having an informal meet-up the evening before the wedding at Krajcar Brewery in Zywiec. Transportation will be available from Beskidian with exact timing provided closer to the date. Food and drinks can be purchased individually. All wedding guests are welcome.
